9. Registration and accuracy

tilePASSGEO-01 PASS tile: measured 0.1137 m median, limit <= 0.5 m median.
Horizontal: source resampled bilinearly to a 10 m grid in WGS84 / UTM. The NAD83 to WGS84 transformation is whatever PROJ selects for this CRS pair. The GDAL version is recorded in build_info.json; the PROJ pipeline string is not captured in `tile.json`. Treat horizontal accuracy as plus or minus one cell (10 m). Vertical: NAVD88 orthometric heights in meters. No vertical datum conversion is applied. Heights are not ellipsoidal (HAE) and not EGM96. A consumer that needs HAE must apply a geoid model.
